defect: broad wildcard opcode arm makes maintenance command unreachable
rationale: Opcode 8'hAF is documented to clear the error. The earlier 1010???? casez item matches AF first and sets start_transfer, so the clear_error arm can never execute.
author: gpt-6.1-sol
